title: Major disaster declaration DR-4907-OR: Severe Storm
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4907-OR, "SEVERE STORMS, STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS, FLOODING, LANDSLIDES, AND MUDSLIDES") for OR, dated 2026-04-07, for an incident of type "Severe Storm". The incident period began on 2025-12-15 and ended on 2025-12-21. The declaration lists 11 designated areas.
